title: Citation auditor supports BVerfG case-number pattern
description:
Add a pattern module for German Federal Constitutional Court (BVerfG) case numbers to the citation auditor. The module follows the CitationPattern interface from ADR-0002 Decision 7 and ships as a Bun + TypeScript file under `skills/audit-citations/scripts/patterns/bverfg.ts`, consistent with ADR-0002 Decision 1 (runtime) and Decision 2 (inline skill script layout).

The pattern registers in `patterns/index.ts` and exposes the standard `parse` + `candidateUrls` methods. URL candidates target `bundesverfassungsgericht.de` per Decision 5. No new dependencies, no new runtime, no new auth surface.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BVerfG pattern parses real case numbers | unit | jest test under tests/patterns/bverfg.test.ts |
| 2 | Pattern registered in patterns/index.ts | review | grep finds the registration |
| 3 | URL candidates point at bundesverfassungsgericht.de | unit | jest assertion on candidateUrls output |
acceptance_criteria:
- patterns/bverfg.ts exports a CitationPattern that parses BVerfG case numbers (e.g. 1 BvR 123/45)
- The pattern is registered in patterns/index.ts and returned by the registry
- candidateUrls() returns at least one URL on bundesverfassungsgericht.de for a parsed citation

metadata.intent: Extend the citation auditor with a new jurisdiction (BVerfG) following ADR-0002. Scope IN: new pattern module, registry entry. Scope OUT: snippet-guard changes, new fetchers, new auth flows.
metadata.contracts: Implements the CitationPattern interface from ADR-0002 Decision 7. Runtime: Bun + TypeScript per ADR-0002 Decision 1.
